$comment: Gate A route coverage, declared. Every route the router declares must be swept, or excluded here with
a reason. A new route that nobody classifies fails the gate by name, instead of quietly never being
crawled. Enforced by @predivo-gmbh/gate-kit/conformance checkRouteCoverage() once this product is
converted to the shared crawl engine.
NOTE the two router sources: App.tsx mounts <Route path="*" element={<AuthenticatedShell />} /> and the
whole authenticated app is declared inside that component. Parsing App.tsx alone reports 5 routes and
hides the other 30, which is how an earlier count of this product was wrong.
Measured 2026-08-20: 35 routes declared across both files, 7 swept. That is the largest coverage gap in
the fleet, and it is recorded here rather than left invisible. Entries with `expires` are real gaps with

exclusions.reason: AUTHENTICATED app route, not swept. It holds a real dialog: the create/edit Approval Chain modal, which the static rule found to have no scroller on 2026-08-20 (fixed in 357ae64) and which the crawl has never once opened. Add to the sweep at conversion.
AUTHENTICATED app route, not swept. Same gap as /settings/approval-chains.

AUTHENTICATED onboarding flow. The e2e identity is already onboarded, so entering it directly would leave that shared account in a half-configured state. Needs a dedicated fresh identity, the way ReplyFlow seeds one.
Needs a seeded company row; the crawl has no fixture data yet.
Query variant of /settings, which is swept.

PUBLIC landing page, wrapped in RedirectIfAuthenticated so an authenticated crawl never sees it. It carries the demo-request modal that the static rule found broken on 2026-08-20 (fixed in 357ae64). Needs an anonymous identity, which lands with the engine conversion.
Auth form page, no dialog-class surface; covered by the auth e2e specs.
NOT a 404 in this product: App.tsx:53 mounts the AuthenticatedShell here, and its child routes are enumerated individually above.
